newsitem.title: USA: Advest Group to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: Advest Group to redeem debentures.

text.p: The Advest Group Inc on Monday said it would redeem all of the company's outstanding nine-percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2008.
The redemption date is January 30, 1997, and the redemption price is set at 101.2 percent of the principal, plus accrued interest, the financial services company said.
The company said the debentures would be convertible into common shares at $13.57 per share.

It said it would use the proceeds from a recent private placement of $35 million of senior notes to make the redemption, which will eliminate the potential dilution of 15 percent of the Advest Group Inc's outstanding shares.
